questions.questionText: Which statement about acceleration is correct?

options.text: It is related to the changing speed of an object.
It is the distance an object travels in one second.
It is the force acting on an object divided by the distance it travels in one second.
It is the force acting on an object when it is near to the Earth.

Which statement about the force exerted by the lift floor on the person’s feet is correct?

options.text: It is less than the person’s weight.
It is equal to the person’s weight.
It is greater than the person’s weight.

A negatively charged plastic rod is brought near to an isolated, uncharged metal sphere and held
there.
What happens when the metal sphere is earthed?

options.text: Electrons flow from the metal sphere to earth.
Electrons flow from earth to the metal sphere.
Positive charge flows from the metal sphere to earth.

Charges flow in only one direction.

original value.
What is the half-life of the isotope?
What causes the phases of the Moon?

options.text: the Earth turning on its axis

questions.questionText:
The Sun is a star that radiates energy towards the Earth.
Which regions of the electromagnetic spectrum make up most of the Sun’s radiation received on
the Earth?

Light received from distant galaxies is observed to have a longer wavelength than the light
originally emitted. This is called redshift.
Which conclusion do astronomers form about distant galaxies from this observation?

options.text: They are all moving around each other.
They are all moving away from each other.
They are all moving in circular orbits.

They are all moving towards each other.
